about: The cases a search finding's structure lines are held to: drawn as markdown with the default English words or a consumer's own, footnote marks as in-page links, a picture's caption, and the opening prose of a set of findings under a limit in UTF-16 units.

findingMarkdown.name: a verdict carrying its words, called by its key
an address with its English label
the consumer's words for a part and a label
part labels alone are headings, a name and a section above them

NAME: Corner Kitchen
SECTION: Prices
SECTION:

A noodle house[1].
INTRO: Opening words
BODY:

findingMarkdown.name: a menu is a folded table with a group row
args:
MENU: Prices as posted[2]
- Noodles
- cold noodles :: 6,000 won
1. hot noodles :: 7,000 won :: spicy :: large
* tea | green :: 2,000 won
ADDRESS: Riverside
findingMarkdown.answer:
::: fold Menu
Prices as posted[2](#mark-2)

| Dish | Price | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Noodles** |  |  |
| cold noodles | 6,000 won |  |
| hot noodles | 7,000 won | spicy · large |
| tea \| green | 2,000 won |  |
:::

**Address** Riverside

findingMarkdown.name: a menu without notes has two columns

- soup :: 9,000 won

- rice :: 1,000 won
# After
findingMarkdown.answer:

| Dish | Price |
| --- | --- |
| soup | 9,000 won |

findingMarkdown.name: an empty finding is empty

footnoteMarks.name: a snippet mark is encoded in its link
a mark followed by an address or a colon is a link

pictureCaption.name: its caption with the shot and the source after it
args: garden group :: Studio A :: outdoor :: official

findingExcerpt.name: the key answer's and the summary's words, without marks or markup
args:
VERDICT: Corner Kitchen[2].
SUMMARY:
1. The cheapest place is **Corner Kitchen**[2].
2. [Blue Door](https://example.com) is `8,000 won`[3†].
findingExcerpt.answer: Corner Kitchen. The cheapest place is Corner Kitchen. Blue Door is 8,000 won.

findingExcerpt.name: what is drawn rather than said and what is folded under MORE are left out
args:
NAME: Corner Kitchen
# Heading
IMAGE: https://example.com/p.jpg :: photo
| menu | price |
---
ADDRESS: Riverside
MENU:
- noodles :: 6,000 won
SUMMARY: A noodle house.
> It has a self-serve bar.
MORE:
a folded story
findingExcerpt.answer: A noodle house. It has a self-serve bar. next finding

findingExcerpt.name: cut at the last space before the limit with an ellipsis
a finding of a name alone says nothing
a cut with no space past half the limit keeps the characters
a rule of stars or dashes is not prose
Hangul is counted in UTF-16 units
args: 국수가 맛있고 값이 쌉니다 그리고 가깝습니다
